title: Clustered federal split learning method, system and medium for human activity recognition
assignee: South China University of Technology SCUT

pse.problem: Addresses the challenge of training a global model with non-IID data in human activity recognition scenarios under resource constraints and device privacy protection.
pse.solution_function: Combines federated learning and split learning to mine non-IID data using a server-side model, employ hierarchical clustering on intermediate feature vectors for faster convergence and improved accuracy in human activity recognition.
pse.solution_structure: Central server with server-side model (W body), each client with lightweight client-side models (W head and W tail).
pse.solution_implementation: Initialization of the server-side model, distribution of lightweight client-side models to clients, computation of intermediate feature vectors on the client-side, reception of intermediate feature vectors by the server, hierarchical clustering of data using these vectors, and federated learning based on clustered data.
pse.effect: Improves final accuracy of federated split learning in human activity recognition scenarios, faster convergence, overcomes cold start challenges of traditional clustering federated learning, and allows for quick re-clustering when a new client joins.
